scope: Evidence for the study's rows (six instances x pair table, inherited-f4, fes-then-inherited, fes-then-batched). No leaderboard row is proposed (owner); this file is the gate evidence only.

rho_reference.kind_note: Koblitz: the signed-Frobenius walk (A = 2n, the automorphism fold) and the negation walk (A = 2) on the same 16 seeds, the lower mean S prices the reference (negation at degrees 13, 17, 19, where the Frobenius walk's set-up dominates; signed-Frobenius at 23); random binary: negation, the only automorphism.
rho_reference.protocol: README 'Protocol': ic bench --sweep, 16 matched rho runs in the same process, rho_reference_rule of each report (Koblitz: lower mean of signed-Frobenius and negation walks on the same seeds; random binary: negation only); one planted target per repeat, 3 repeats per IC configuration, verified recovery.
rho_reference.binary_or_process: the same ic bench process per instance writes every IC row and the matched rho (producer binary sha256 1f566eed..., built at 4900647bcd per the benchmark record; replayed with the validator's build of d81dc1241b, sha256 0836dc46..., every count identical)
rho_reference.gae_band_basis: for each weight, the instance with the smallest S(fes-then-batched)/S(rho) (docs/ic/runs/VALIDATION.json convention); the IC arm is fes-then-batched
rho_reference.band_formula: S(w) = mean over repeats of [G - C + w (U + n_C)] / sqrt r: G total GAE; C and n_C the GAE and count of the calibration-priced native counters (price_phase's ten counters with a non-null unit, pinned on Koblitz and measured on random binary, plus the solver's ops at ns_per_op); U the arm's unpriced counts (no *_uncharged counter occurs; work_native.table_insert_attempts behind counted:table_insert_attempts, the 2026-11-08 default reading, i.e. the pair table's per-step inserts). Rho: no unpriced counter emitted, U_rho = 0 (lower bound at w > 0).
rho_reference.order_holds_across_band_means: The matched rho is below fes-then-batched, and below every IC arm (pair table, inherited-f4, fes-then-inherited), at w = 0, 0.1 and 1 on all six instances; no IC arm is ranked ahead of rho anywhere. It does NOT mean fes-then-batched ranks first among the IC rows: see component_orders.

fes_then_batched_vs_inherited_f4.reading: A tie at w = 0 on random 15, Koblitz 17, 19, random 21, Koblitz 23 (identical decisions; solver word XORs free), fes-then-batched lower at w = 0.1 and 1; at Koblitz 13 fes-then-batched is above at w = 0 (fes-f2 tried more targets) and below at w = 0.1 and 1: unresolved there. Weak order (<=) on five of six.

rho_reference.sensitivity: rho charged k = 1 or k = n + 1 native operations per walk step (validation/band.json diagnostics.rho_ext_*) and fes-then-batched / inherited-f4 priced by the complete bitop/v1 solver tally (diagnostics.bitop_band_*): no order verdict changes.
caveats: 3 repeats per IC configuration, 16 rho runs per walk; no confidence intervals
local container, not isolated (operation counts only; wall time is not part of S)
both rows of every pair (IC arm and matched rho, and every IC-vs-IC pair) come from one ic bench process per instance
random-binary rows are priced by host-measured ratios: their S at the run's calibration point is not reproducible (replay: -20% to -33% on the algebraic rows); the band, computed from counts, is
the matched rho emits no unpriced counter (canonicalisations, distinguished-point tests, Frobenius maps): its band is flat, a lower bound at w > 0
discrete-log recovery is a known-answer check (recovered = planted per repeat); the reports carry no base point or target for an independent [k]P = Q check
the validator holds no keyring key; under docs/SABOTAGE_RESISTANCE.md the independent booleans here are unsigned and pcc grades these proofs not_covered
